hostname rt-g01
!
interface GigabitEthernet0/0
 description sample wan
 ip address 203.0.113.1 255.255.255.224
 ip access-group Gi0-0-in in
 ip nat outside
 no shutdown
!
interface GigabitEthernet0/1
 description sample lan
 ip address 198.51.100.1 255.255.255.0
 ip nat inside
 no shutdown
!
ip sla 1
 icmp-echo 203.0.113.2 source-interface GigabitEthernet0/0
 frequency 5
ip sla schedule 1 life forever start-time now
track 1 ip sla 1 reachability
 delay down 25
!
ip route 0.0.0.0 0.0.0.0 203.0.113.2 1 track 1
!
ip access-list extended acl-g-mgmt
 permit ip 192.0.2.0 0.0.0.127 any
!
ip access-list extended acl-g-nat
 permit ip 198.51.100.0 0.0.0.127 any
!
ip access-list extended acl-g-pool
 permit ip 198.51.100.128 0.0.0.127 any
!
ip access-list extended acl-g-wan
 permit tcp any any established
 permit tcp any host 203.0.113.1 eq 80
 permit udp any eq 53 any range 1024 65535
 permit icmp any any echo-reply
!
ip access-list extended Gi0-0-in
 permit ip 192.0.2.0 0.0.0.127 any
 permit tcp any any established
 permit tcp any host 203.0.113.1 eq 80
 permit udp any eq 53 any range 1024 65535
 permit icmp any any echo-reply
!
ip nat inside source list acl-g-nat interface GigabitEthernet0/0 overload
ip nat inside source static tcp 198.51.100.10 8080 interface GigabitEthernet0/0 80
ip nat pool nat3 203.0.113.17 203.0.113.22 prefix-length 27
ip nat inside source list acl-g-pool pool nat3
!
ip dhcp pool dhcp-g-lan
 network 198.51.100.0 255.255.255.0
 default-router 198.51.100.1
 lease 0 1 30
!
end
